plan: Implement immutable workspaces using defensive copies and sorted segment snapshots.
Retarget note/link attachments across split and join lineage; derive exports and indexes from current segments.
Use a restricted three-way merge for corrections and tag additions, raising readable text conflicts.

trace.source_relation: Cutting a strip creates labeled descendants rather than erasing its identity.
trace.target_mechanism: Split creates caller-named descendant segments and retargets every attached note and link to both descendants.

trace.source_relation: Revision sheets cite the preserved originals.
trace.target_mechanism: Immutable workspace snapshots and ID-based comparison preserve revision traceability while attachment sets resolve to current segments.

trace.source_relation: Edits on separate strips can be filed together, but competing marks on one strip conflict.
trace.target_mechanism: The three-way merge combines disjoint corrections and tag additions but raises ConflictError for differing corrections to the same segment ID.
